# sreagent_slack (Data Source)

The organization's Slack workspace. One row per organization: creating it adopts the current settings, destroying it leaves them in place.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sreagent_slack" "this" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `app_token_set` (Boolean) Whether a Socket Mode app token is stored.
- `bot_token_set` (Boolean) Whether the platform holds a value for bot_token.
- `default_channel_critical` (String) Where critical alerts post when no route names a channel.
- `default_channel_info` (String) Where info alerts post when no route names a channel.
- `default_channel_remediation` (String) Where remediation updates post.
- `default_channel_warning` (String) Where warning alerts post when no route names a channel.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the workspace is used.
- `id` (String) The row's identifier on the platform.
- `name` (String) A label for the workspace; required on first configuration.
- `priority` (Number) Order among workspaces.
- `signing_secret_set` (Boolean) Whether the platform holds a value for signing_secret.
- `team_id` (String) The T... workspace id, verified against Slack with the bot token.
- `workspace_name` (String) The workspace's name.
